contracts.startup_history: Remove completed only; queued/running/cancelling/paused become interrupted without starting work; failed/cancelled/interrupted are retained.
contracts.automatic_retention: Retain all interrupted requests independently; limit completed/failed/cancelled history to the latest 200 entries.

selected_sync.source_selection: Folders only; destination paths are same-name child folders; unselected destination scopes stay untouched.
selected_sync.ordinary_filter: Anchored, literal selected scopes followed by exclude-all, applied to both endpoints.
selected_sync.selection_with_includes: A bounded metadata listing from both endpoints supplies the union of matching selected paths; this permits deletion of stale destination-only matches.
selected_sync.missing_destination: Only rclone exit 3 (directory not found) is accepted as empty.

automatic_modify_window.both_local_endpoints: Choose the maximum known precision; find nearest existing ancestor for a missing target.
automatic_modify_window.limitation: A same-size change inside the chosen time tolerance may be skipped; macOS statfs branch awaits Mac CI execution.

transfer_report.comparison_input: Separate stdout callback appends raw output across retries; stderr remains JSON logs/stats.
transfer_report.summary: Event counts remain separate from rclone file counters; skippedFiles and failedFiles are unknown (null), not computed from checks.
transfer_report.comparison_summary_frequency: Existing stderr statistics about once per second and final pipe drain; explicit page reads use the writer snapshot.
transfer_report.write_failure: Report, raw-log and persistence failures request graceful stop rather than directly killing the rclone child.
transfer_report.raw_line_limit: Incomplete or malformed combined lines remain in raw export and are counted as a parsing limitation.
